#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""T02: load Eurostat-style city indicator values into normalized long CSV."""

import csv
import json
import math
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
T01_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t01_selected_indicators.csv"
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "sample_api_config.json"
SAMPLE_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
OUT_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t02_eurostat_raw.csv"

OUTPUT_FIELDS = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]


def clean(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().strip('"').strip()


def norm_key(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", clean(value).lower())


def find_col(headers, candidates, avoid=None):
    headers = list(headers or [])

    for candidate in candidates:
        for header in headers:
            if header == candidate and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_lower = clean(candidate).lower()
        for header in headers:
            if clean(header).lower() == c_lower and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        for header in headers:
            if norm_key(header) == c_norm and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        if len(c_norm) >= 3:
            for header in headers:
                if c_norm in norm_key(header) and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                    return header

    return None


def read_selected_indicators():
    selected = {}
    if not T01_PATH.exists():
        return selected

    with T01_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []

        id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_id", "indicator", "indicator_code", "indic_id", "code",
            "eurostat_indicator", "selected_indicator_id", "selected_indicators",
            "Indicator ID", "Indicator",
        ])
        name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_name", "name", "indicator_label", "label", "title",
            "Indicator Name",
        ])
        unit_col = find_col(headers, [
            "unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units", "Unit",
        ])

        if id_col is None and headers:
            id_col = headers[0]

        for row in reader:
            raw = clean(row.get(id_col, "")) if id_col else ""
            if not raw:
                continue

            parts = [part.strip() for part in re.split(r"[;|,]", raw) if part.strip()]
            for indicator_id in parts:
                entry = selected.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                name = clean(row.get(name_col, "")) if name_col else ""
                unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""
                if name:
                    entry["name"] = name
                if unit:
                    entry["unit"] = unit

    return selected


def collect_config_metadata(obj, metadata):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        indicator_id = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_id", "indic_id", "indicator", "indic", "id", "code", "key"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                indicator_id = clean(value)
                break

        name = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                name = clean(value)
                break

        unit = None
        for key_name in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                unit = clean(value)
                break

        if indicator_id:
            entry = metadata.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
            if name:
                entry["name"] = name
            if unit:
                entry["unit"] = unit

        generic_keys = {
            "indicators", "dimensions", "data", "meta", "metadata", "config",
            "params", "query", "dataset", "version", "source", "updated",
            "columns", "fields", "options", "filters",
        }

        for key_name, value in obj.items():
            if isinstance(key_name, str) and isinstance(value, dict) and key_name not in generic_keys:
                key_clean = clean(key_name)

                value_name = None
                for name_key in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
                    candidate = value.get(name_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_name = clean(candidate)
                        break

                value_unit = None
                for unit_key in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
                    candidate = value.get(unit_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_unit = clean(candidate)
                        break

                if key_clean and (value_name or value_unit):
                    entry = metadata.setdefault(key_clean, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                    if value_name:
                        entry["name"] = value_name
                    if value_unit:
                        entry["unit"] = value_unit

            collect_config_metadata(value, metadata)

    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for item in obj:
            collect_config_metadata(item, metadata)


def read_config_metadata():
    metadata = {}
    if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
        try:
            with CONFIG_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
                data = json.load(handle)
            collect_config_metadata(data, metadata)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return metadata


def build_lookups(selected, config):
    id_lookup = {}
    name_lookup = {}

    for indicator_id in selected:
        id_lookup[indicator_id] = indicator_id
        id_lookup[norm_key(indicator_id)] = indicator_id

    for indicator_id in selected:
        md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
        cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
        name = md.get("name") or cfg.get("name") or indicator_id
        name_lookup[norm_key(name)] = indicator_id
        name_lookup[norm_key(indicator_id)] = indicator_id

    return id_lookup, name_lookup


def canonical_indicator(raw, id_lookup, name_lookup):
    value = clean(raw)
    if not value:
        return None

    if value in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[value]

    key = norm_key(value)
    if key in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[key]
    if key in name_lookup:
        return name_lookup[key]

    return None


def substring_indicator(raw, selected, config):
    hk = norm_key(raw)
    if not hk:
        return None

    for indicator_id in selected:
        md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
        cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
        aliases = [indicator_id, md.get("name", ""), cfg.get("name", "")]
        for alias in aliases:
            ak = norm_key(alias)
            if len(ak) >= 3 and ak in hk:
                return indicator_id

    return None


def indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config):
    md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
    cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
    name = md.get("name") or cfg.get("name") or ""
    unit = md.get("unit") or cfg.get("unit") or ""
    return name, unit


def parse_number(raw):
    text = clean(raw)
    if not text:
        return None

    lower = text.lower()
    if lower in {"na", "n/a", "nan", "none", "null", "-", ":", "..", "...", "--"}:
        return None

    text = text.replace("\u00a0", "").replace(" ", "")

    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        pass

    text = re.sub(r"[^0-9+\-.,]", "", text)
    if not text:
        return None

    if "," in text and "." in text:
        if text.rfind(",") > text.rfind("."):
            text = text.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", "")
    elif "," in text:
        parts = text.split(",")
        if (
            len(parts) > 1
            and all(len(part) == 3 for part in parts[1:])
            and parts[0].lstrip("+-").isdigit()
        ):
            text = "".join(parts)
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", ".")

    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None

    return None


def format_number(value):
    if abs(value - round(value)) < 1e-12:
        return str(int(round(value)))
    return repr(value)


def extract_year(raw):
    text = clean(raw)
    if not text:
        return ""

    match = re.search(r"(19|20)\d{2}", text)
    if match:
        return match.group(0)

    return text


def read_sample_rows(selected, config, id_lookup, name_lookup):
    rows = []
    if not SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        return rows

    with SAMPLE_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []

        city_id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "city_id", "city_code", "city", "geo", "geo_id", "urban_audit",
            "cities", "citycode", "city_id_code", "code",
        ])
        city_name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "city_name", "city_label", "geo_label", "cityname", "name", "label",
            "City Name", "city",
        ], avoid=city_id_col)
        year_col = find_col(headers, [
            "year", "time_period", "time", "period", "date", "yr", "TIME_PERIOD",
        ])
        indicator_id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_id", "indicator", "indic_id", "indicator_code", "indic",
            "variable", "series", "INDICATOR", "indic_code",
        ], avoid=city_id_col)
        indicator_name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_name", "indicator_label", "indicator_title", "Indicator Name",
        ], avoid=city_name_col)
        value_col = find_col(headers, [
            "value", "obs_value", "observation", "val", "value_num", "OBS_VALUE",
            "values", "measure",
        ])
        unit_col = find_col(headers, [
            "unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units", "UNIT",
        ])

        is_long = bool(value_col and (indicator_id_col or indicator_name_col))

        if is_long:
            for row in reader:
                raw_indicator = (
                    row.get(indicator_id_col, "")
                    if indicator_id_col
                    else row.get(indicator_name_col, "")
                )
                indicator_id = canonical_indicator(raw_indicator, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                if not indicator_id:
                    indicator_id = substring_indicator(raw_indicator, selected, config)
                if not indicator_id:
                    continue

                city_id = clean(row.get(city_id_col, "")) if city_id_col else ""
                city_name = clean(row.get(city_name_col, "")) if city_name_col else ""
                if not city_id and city_name:
                    city_id = city_name
                if not city_name:
                    city_name = city_id

                year = extract_year(row.get(year_col, "")) if year_col else ""
                value = parse_number(row.get(value_col, ""))
                if value is None:
                    continue

                row_name = clean(row.get(indicator_name_col, "")) if indicator_name_col else ""
                row_unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""
                meta_name, meta_unit = indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config)

                rows.append({
                    "city_id": city_id,
                    "city_name": city_name,
                    "year": year,
                    "indicator_id": indicator_id,
                    "indicator_name": meta_name or row_name or indicator_id,
                    "value": value,
                    "unit": meta_unit or row_unit,
                })

        else:
            dimension_cols = {
                col for col in (
                    city_id_col, city_name_col, year_col, unit_col, indicator_name_col
                ) if col
            }

            for row in reader:
                city_id = clean(row.get(city_id_col, "")) if city_id_col else ""
                city_name = clean(row.get(city_name_col, "")) if city_name_col else ""
                if not city_id and city_name:
                    city_id = city_name
                if not city_name:
                    city_name = city_id

                year = extract_year(row.get(year_col, "")) if year_col else ""
                row_unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""

                for header in headers:
                    if header in dimension_cols:
                        continue

                    header_key = norm_key(header)
                    if (
                        any(skip in header_key for skip in ("unit", "flag", "note", "comment"))
                        and not canonical_indicator(header, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                    ):
                        continue

                    indicator_id = canonical_indicator(header, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                    if not indicator_id:
                        indicator_id = substring_indicator(header, selected, config)
                    if not indicator_id:
                        continue

                    value = parse_number(row.get(header, ""))
                    if value is None:
                        continue

                    meta_name, meta_unit = indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config)

                    rows.append({
                        "city_id": city_id,
                        "city_name": city_name,
                        "year": year,
                        "indicator_id": indicator_id,
                        "indicator_name": meta_name or indicator_id,
                        "value": value,
                        "unit": meta_unit or row_unit,
                    })

    return rows


def main():
    selected = read_selected_indicators()
    config = read_config_metadata()
    id_lookup, name_lookup = build_lookups(selected, config)

    rows = read_sample_rows(selected, config, id_lookup, name_lookup)

    seen = set()
    deduped = []
    for row in rows:
        key = (row["city_id"], row["year"], row["indicator_id"])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        deduped.append(row)

    deduped.sort(key=lambda row: (row["city_id"], row["year"], row["indicator_id"]))

    OUT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with OUT_PATH.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            handle,
            fieldnames=OUTPUT_FIELDS,
            quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
            lineterminator="\n",
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in deduped:
            writer.writerow({field: row.get(field, "") for field in OUTPUT_FIELDS})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    # contains, but only if candidate length >= 3

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""T02: load Eurostat-style city indicator values into normalized long CSV."""

import csv
import json
import math
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
T01_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t01_selected_indicators.csv"
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "sample_api_config.json"
SAMPLE_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
OUT_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t02_eurostat_raw.csv"

OUTPUT_FIELDS = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]


def clean(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().strip('"').strip()


def norm_key(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", clean(value).lower())


def find_col(headers, candidates, avoid=None):
    headers = list(headers or [])
    # exact
    for candidate in candidates:
        for header in headers:
            if header == candidate and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header
    # case-insensitive
    for candidate in candidates:
        c_lower = clean(candidate).lower()
        for header in headers:
            if clean(header).lower() == c_lower and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header
    # normalized
    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        for header in headers:
            if norm_key(header) == c_norm and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header
    # contained
    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        if len(c_norm) >= 3:
            for header in headers:
                if c_norm in norm_key(header) and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                    return header
    return None


def read_selected_indicators():
    selected = {}
    if not T01_PATH.exists():
        return selected
    with T01_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []
        id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_id", "indicator", "indicator_code", "indic_id", "code",
            "eurostat_indicator", "selected_indicator_id", "selected_indicators",
            "Indicator ID", "Indicator",
        ])
        name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_name", "name", "indicator_label", "label", "title",
            "Indicator Name",
        ])
        unit_col = find_col(headers, [
            "unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units", "Unit",
        ])
        if id_col is None and headers:
            id_col = headers[0]
        for row in reader:
            raw = clean(row.get(id_col, "")) if id_col else ""
            if not raw:
                continue
            parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"[;|]", raw) if p.strip()]
            for indicator_id in parts:
                entry = selected.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                name = clean(row.get(name_col, "")) if name_col else ""
                unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""
                if name:
                    entry["name"] = name
                if unit:
                    entry["unit"] = unit
    return selected


def collect_config_metadata(obj, metadata):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        # A metadata object for one indicator.
        indicator_id = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_id", "indic_id", "indicator", "indic", "id", "code", "key"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                indicator_id = clean(value)
                break
        name = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                name = clean(value)
                break
        unit = None
        for key_name in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                unit = clean(value)
                break
        if indicator_id:
            entry = metadata.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
            if name:
                entry["name"] = name
            if unit:
                entry["unit"] = unit

        # A mapping from indicator id to metadata.
        generic_keys = {
            "indicators", "dimensions", "data", "meta", "metadata", "config",
            "params", "query", "dataset", "version", "source", "updated",
            "columns", "fields", "options", "filters",
        }
        for key_name, value in obj.items():
            if isinstance(key_name, str) and isinstance(value, dict) and key_name not in generic_keys:
                key_clean = clean(key_name)
                value_name = None
                for name_key in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
                    candidate = value.get(name_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_name = clean(candidate)
                        break
                value_unit = None
                for unit_key in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
                    candidate = value.get(unit_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_unit = clean(candidate)
                        break
                if key_clean and (value_name or value_unit):
                    entry = metadata.setdefault(key_clean, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                    if value_name:
                        entry["name"] = value_name
                    if value_unit:
                        entry["unit"] = value_unit
            collect_config_metadata(value, metadata)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for item in obj:
            collect_config_metadata(item, metadata)


def read_config_metadata():
    metadata = {}
    if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
        try:
            with CONFIG_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
                data = json.load(handle)
            collect_config_metadata(data, metadata)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return metadata

def canonical_indicator(raw, id_lookup, name_lookup):
    value = clean(raw)
    if not value:
        return None
    if value in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[value]
    k = norm_key(value)
    if k in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[k]
    if k in name_lookup:
        return name_lookup[k]
    return None


def substring_indicator(header, selected):

    if not hk:
        return None
    for indicator_id in selected:
        ik = norm_key(indicator_id)
        if len(ik) >= 2 and ik in hk:

    return None

def parse_number(raw):
    text = clean(raw)
    if not text:
        return None
    lower = text.lower()
    if lower in {"na", "n/a", "nan", "none", "null", "-", ":", "..", "...", "--"}:
        return None
    text = text.replace("\u00a0", "").replace(" ", "")
    # direct parse
    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    # keep numeric chars and separators
    text = re.sub(r"[^0-9eE+\-.,]", "", text)
    if not text:
        return None
    if "," in text and "." in text:
        if text.rfind(",") > text.rfind("."):
            text = text.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", "")
    elif "," in text:
        parts = text.split(",")
        if len(parts) > 1 and all(len(part) == 3 for part in parts[1:]) and parts[0].lstrip("+-").isdigit():
            text = "".join(parts)
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", ".")
    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return None


def format_number(value):
    if abs(value - round(value)) < 1e-12:
        return str(int(round(value)))
    return repr(value)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""T02: load Eurostat-style city indicator values into normalized long CSV."""

import csv
import json
import math
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
T01_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t01_selected_indicators.csv"
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "sample_api_config.json"
SAMPLE_PATH = ROOT / "inputs" / "eurostat" / "eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
OUT_PATH = ROOT / "outputs" / "t02_eurostat_raw.csv"

OUTPUT_FIELDS = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]


def clean(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().strip('"').strip()


def norm_key(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", clean(value).lower())


def find_col(headers, candidates, avoid=None):
    headers = list(headers or [])

    for candidate in candidates:
        for header in headers:
            if header == candidate and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_lower = clean(candidate).lower()
        for header in headers:
            if clean(header).lower() == c_lower and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        for header in headers:
            if norm_key(header) == c_norm and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                return header

    for candidate in candidates:
        c_norm = norm_key(candidate)
        if len(c_norm) >= 3:
            for header in headers:
                if c_norm in norm_key(header) and (avoid is None or header != avoid):
                    return header

    return None


def read_selected_indicators():
    selected = {}
    if not T01_PATH.exists():
        return selected

    with T01_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []

        id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_id", "indicator", "indicator_code", "indic_id", "code",
            "eurostat_indicator", "selected_indicator_id", "selected_indicators",
            "Indicator ID", "Indicator",
        ])
        name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_name", "name", "indicator_label", "label", "title",
            "Indicator Name",
        ])
        unit_col = find_col(headers, [
            "unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units", "Unit",
        ])

        if id_col is None and headers:
            id_col = headers[0]

        for row in reader:
            raw = clean(row.get(id_col, "")) if id_col else ""
            if not raw:
                continue

            parts = [part.strip() for part in re.split(r"[;|,]", raw) if part.strip()]
            for indicator_id in parts:
                entry = selected.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                name = clean(row.get(name_col, "")) if name_col else ""
                unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""
                if name:
                    entry["name"] = name
                if unit:
                    entry["unit"] = unit

    return selected


def collect_config_metadata(obj, metadata):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        indicator_id = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_id", "indic_id", "indicator", "indic", "id", "code", "key"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                indicator_id = clean(value)
                break

        name = None
        for key_name in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                name = clean(value)
                break

        unit = None
        for key_name in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
            value = obj.get(key_name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and clean(value):
                unit = clean(value)
                break

        if indicator_id:
            entry = metadata.setdefault(indicator_id, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
            if name:
                entry["name"] = name
            if unit:
                entry["unit"] = unit

        generic_keys = {
            "indicators", "dimensions", "data", "meta", "metadata", "config",
            "params", "query", "dataset", "version", "source", "updated",
            "columns", "fields", "options", "filters",
        }

        for key_name, value in obj.items():
            if isinstance(key_name, str) and isinstance(value, dict) and key_name not in generic_keys:
                key_clean = clean(key_name)

                value_name = None
                for name_key in ("indicator_name", "name", "label", "title", "indicator_label"):
                    candidate = value.get(name_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_name = clean(candidate)
                        break

                value_unit = None
                for unit_key in ("unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units"):
                    candidate = value.get(unit_key)
                    if isinstance(candidate, str) and clean(candidate):
                        value_unit = clean(candidate)
                        break

                if key_clean and (value_name or value_unit):
                    entry = metadata.setdefault(key_clean, {"name": "", "unit": ""})
                    if value_name:
                        entry["name"] = value_name
                    if value_unit:
                        entry["unit"] = value_unit

            collect_config_metadata(value, metadata)

    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for item in obj:
            collect_config_metadata(item, metadata)


def read_config_metadata():
    metadata = {}
    if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
        try:
            with CONFIG_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
                data = json.load(handle)
            collect_config_metadata(data, metadata)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return metadata


def build_lookups(selected, config):
    id_lookup = {}
    name_lookup = {}

    for indicator_id in selected:
        id_lookup[indicator_id] = indicator_id
        id_lookup[norm_key(indicator_id)] = indicator_id

    for indicator_id in selected:
        md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
        cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
        name = md.get("name") or cfg.get("name") or indicator_id
        name_lookup[norm_key(name)] = indicator_id
        name_lookup[norm_key(indicator_id)] = indicator_id

    return id_lookup, name_lookup


def canonical_indicator(raw, id_lookup, name_lookup):
    value = clean(raw)
    if not value:
        return None

    if value in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[value]

    key = norm_key(value)
    if key in id_lookup:
        return id_lookup[key]
    if key in name_lookup:
        return name_lookup[key]

    return None


def substring_indicator(raw, selected, config):
    hk = norm_key(raw)
    if not hk:
        return None

    for indicator_id in selected:
        md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
        cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
        aliases = [indicator_id, md.get("name", ""), cfg.get("name", "")]
        for alias in aliases:
            ak = norm_key(alias)
            if len(ak) >= 3 and ak in hk:
                return indicator_id

    return None


def indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config):
    md = selected.get(indicator_id, {})
    cfg = config.get(indicator_id, {})
    name = md.get("name") or cfg.get("name") or ""
    unit = md.get("unit") or cfg.get("unit") or ""
    return name, unit


def parse_number(raw):
    text = clean(raw)
    if not text:
        return None

    lower = text.lower()
    if lower in {"na", "n/a", "nan", "none", "null", "-", ":", "..", "...", "--"}:
        return None

    text = text.replace("\u00a0", "").replace(" ", "")

    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        pass

    text = re.sub(r"[^0-9+\-.,]", "", text)
    if not text:
        return None

    if "," in text and "." in text:
        if text.rfind(",") > text.rfind("."):
            text = text.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", "")
    elif "," in text:
        parts = text.split(",")
        if (
            len(parts) > 1
            and all(len(part) == 3 for part in parts[1:])
            and parts[0].lstrip("+-").isdigit()
        ):
            text = "".join(parts)
        else:
            text = text.replace(",", ".")

    try:
        value = float(text)
        if math.isfinite(value):
            return format_number(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None

    return None


def format_number(value):
    if abs(value - round(value)) < 1e-12:
        return str(int(round(value)))
    return repr(value)


def extract_year(raw):
    text = clean(raw)
    if not text:
        return ""

    match = re.search(r"(19|20)\d{2}", text)
    if match:
        return match.group(0)

    return text


def read_sample_rows(selected, config, id_lookup, name_lookup):
    rows = []
    if not SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
        return rows

    with SAMPLE_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        headers = reader.fieldnames or []

        city_id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "city_id", "city_code", "city", "geo", "geo_id", "urban_audit",
            "cities", "citycode", "city_id_code", "code",
        ])
        city_name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "city_name", "city_label", "geo_label", "cityname", "name", "label",
            "City Name", "city",
        ], avoid=city_id_col)
        year_col = find_col(headers, [
            "year", "time_period", "time", "period", "date", "yr", "TIME_PERIOD",
        ])
        indicator_id_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_id", "indicator", "indic_id", "indicator_code", "indic",
            "variable", "series", "INDICATOR", "indic_code",
        ], avoid=city_id_col)
        indicator_name_col = find_col(headers, [
            "indicator_name", "indicator_label", "indicator_title", "Indicator Name",
        ], avoid=city_name_col)
        value_col = find_col(headers, [
            "value", "obs_value", "observation", "val", "value_num", "OBS_VALUE",
            "values", "measure",
        ])
        unit_col = find_col(headers, [
            "unit", "unit_code", "unit_name", "units", "UNIT",
        ])

        is_long = bool(value_col and (indicator_id_col or indicator_name_col))

        if is_long:
            for row in reader:
                raw_indicator = (
                    row.get(indicator_id_col, "")
                    if indicator_id_col
                    else row.get(indicator_name_col, "")
                )
                indicator_id = canonical_indicator(raw_indicator, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                if not indicator_id:
                    indicator_id = substring_indicator(raw_indicator, selected, config)
                if not indicator_id:
                    continue

                city_id = clean(row.get(city_id_col, "")) if city_id_col else ""
                city_name = clean(row.get(city_name_col, "")) if city_name_col else ""
                if not city_id and city_name:
                    city_id = city_name
                if not city_name:
                    city_name = city_id

                year = extract_year(row.get(year_col, "")) if year_col else ""
                value = parse_number(row.get(value_col, ""))
                if value is None:
                    continue

                row_name = clean(row.get(indicator_name_col, "")) if indicator_name_col else ""
                row_unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""
                meta_name, meta_unit = indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config)

                rows.append({
                    "city_id": city_id,
                    "city_name": city_name,
                    "year": year,
                    "indicator_id": indicator_id,
                    "indicator_name": meta_name or row_name or indicator_id,
                    "value": value,
                    "unit": meta_unit or row_unit,
                })

        else:
            dimension_cols = {
                col for col in (
                    city_id_col, city_name_col, year_col, unit_col, indicator_name_col
                ) if col
            }

            for row in reader:
                city_id = clean(row.get(city_id_col, "")) if city_id_col else ""
                city_name = clean(row.get(city_name_col, "")) if city_name_col else ""
                if not city_id and city_name:
                    city_id = city_name
                if not city_name:
                    city_name = city_id

                year = extract_year(row.get(year_col, "")) if year_col else ""
                row_unit = clean(row.get(unit_col, "")) if unit_col else ""

                for header in headers:
                    if header in dimension_cols:
                        continue

                    header_key = norm_key(header)
                    if (
                        any(skip in header_key for skip in ("unit", "flag", "note", "comment"))
                        and not canonical_indicator(header, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                    ):
                        continue

                    indicator_id = canonical_indicator(header, id_lookup, name_lookup)
                    if not indicator_id:
                        indicator_id = substring_indicator(header, selected, config)
                    if not indicator_id:
                        continue

                    value = parse_number(row.get(header, ""))
                    if value is None:
                        continue

                    meta_name, meta_unit = indicator_meta(indicator_id, selected, config)

                    rows.append({
                        "city_id": city_id,
                        "city_name": city_name,
                        "year": year,
                        "indicator_id": indicator_id,
                        "indicator_name": meta_name or indicator_id,
                        "value": value,
                        "unit": meta_unit or row_unit,
                    })

    return rows


def main():
    selected = read_selected_indicators()
    config = read_config_metadata()
    id_lookup, name_lookup = build_lookups(selected, config)

    rows = read_sample_rows(selected, config, id_lookup, name_lookup)

    seen = set()
    deduped = []
    for row in rows:
        key = (row["city_id"], row["year"], row["indicator_id"])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        deduped.append(row)

    deduped.sort(key=lambda row: (row["city_id"], row["year"], row["indicator_id"]))

    OUT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with OUT_PATH.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            handle,
            fieldnames=OUTPUT_FIELDS,
            quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
            lineterminator="\n",
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in deduped:
            writer.writerow({field: row.get(field, "") for field in OUTPUT_FIELDS})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
